title: Olney's white squirrel count, from paper maps to mobile devices
summary: Olney, Illinois, calls itself the Home of the White Squirrels. The City has counted them every year since 1977. This year the count moved online and expanded.
credit_note: White Squirrel Count, administered by City Clerk Kelsie Sterchi
cover_alt: An Olney family on a residential street pointing up at a squirrel in the trees, one of them writing on a clipboard
cover_credit: Counting on a residential street. Photo: City of Olney.
